result.title: RoadState: A Domain-Prior-Enhanced Vision-Language System for Industrial-Grade Lane-Level Map Updating
result.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Accepted to AAAI-IAAI 2027, poster presentation
result.summary: Lane-level map updating requires temporally consistent, physically valid, and auditable road-scene semantics despite occlusions, ambiguous lane markings, temporary obstacles, and viewpoint changes. We present RoadState, a production-deployed vision-language system that transforms sequential road-scene observations into structured lane-level semantics for Baidu Maps' map-updating pipeline. Its core model, RoadState-VLM, formulates road-scene understanding as autoregressive state estimation, predicting the current structured road state from the previous observation and symbolic state together with the current observation. We introduce Geometric Chain-of-Thought (Geo-CoT), which uses a directed acyclic graph of semantic dependencies as a domain prior to improve semantic consistency and reasoning fidelity across interdependent road-state dimensions. Extensive experiments on a real-world dataset show that RoadState-VLM achieves 94.33% mean accuracy across six road-state dimensions, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned VLM baseline. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary effectiveness of Geo-CoT and temporal transition context. A cascaded routing pipeline directs routine cases to lightweight models while reserving complex cases for RoadState-VLM. Since its deployment in March 2025, RoadState has supported lane-level map updating across more than 360 cities and reduced overall production costs by 30%. Together with human-in-the-loop auditing, the system maintains robust performance under stress-test conditions. These results demonstrate how domain-prior-enhanced reasoning, structured state interfaces, selective routing, and human quality control can bridge the gap between VLM-based road-scene understanding and large-scale lane-level map updating.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向车道级地图更新的视觉语言系统 RoadState，把道路场景理解建模为自回归状态估计，由前一观测与符号状态预测当前结构化道路状态，并用语义依赖 DAG 作为领域先验（Geo-CoT）提升各状态维度间的一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结构化状态接口 + 时序状态转移 + 按难度级联路由」的工程做法，可能与 LVR 中推理状态如何表示、如何随观测更新以及动态分配计算的问题相关，可供核查；但输出为符号状态而非 latent，属应用系统，联系间接。
